steps.text: Once the participant has signed, the document shows **"Signed electronically"**. The signed and sealed PDF has become its final version: there is nothing to upload.
steps.title: The document is signed

steps.text: **"Evidence"** downloads the evidence report: who signed, when, on whose behalf, and the document's fingerprint. Keep it with the dossier: it attests the signature.
steps.title: The proof of the signature

steps.text: Click **"Follow"** to open the request's page.
steps.title: Open the signature request

steps.text: Each signer is listed with the date of their signature. When someone else signs for the participant, the line says **"In the name and on behalf of"** the participant and **"Signed by"** the person who signed, as the PDF does.
steps.title: Who signed

steps.text: **"Download the signed document"** gives the sealed PDF. **"Evidence (PDF)"** is the readable report, **"Evidence (JSON)"** the same facts for an automated check.
steps.title: The signed document and its evidence

steps.text: The **"History"** traces every step, from the request's creation to the finalised document. **"Log intact"** confirms that nobody has changed it since.
steps.title: The history
